Bash(git commit -m "Create account activation page for user password setup

Added:
- ActivateAccount.tsx page component
- Token validation on page load
- Beautiful UI matching MBZ branding (#800020)
- Password strength validation (min 8 characters)
- Password confirmation field
- Show/hide password toggles
- Account info display (email, organization, role)
- Auto-login after activation with JWT token
- Error states for invalid/expired tokens
- Loading states during validation and activation

Flow:
1. User clicks activation link from email
2. Token is validated with backend
3. User sees their account details
4. User sets password (min 8 chars)
5. Account activated and email verified
6. Auto-logged in and redirected to dashboard

Route: /activate-account?token={activationToken}
